new_nodes.label: Interpreting rusting experiment results: air and water both required
new_nodes.objective: Interpret comparative rusting experiment results to conclude that both air and water are necessary for rusting.
essentialPoints: Rust only forms in the tube where iron is exposed to both air and water
Absence of rust in the air-only or water-only (no air) tubes shows both substances are required

upsertNodes.label: Setting up experiments to test conditions needed for rusting
upsertNodes.objective: Describe how to set up experiments to test which conditions (air, water) are necessary for rusting.
essentialPoints: Set up test tubes with iron exposed to: air+water, air only (dry), water only (no air, e.g. boiled/oil-sealed)
